In this folder

Images and ISOs with their checksums. Everything stays on this machine.

Save the ISO

Copies the bootable ISO into your Downloads folder and verifies it against its checksum, so you can share it, archive it, or write it with any tool.

Write to a USB stick

Makes a stick that boots straight into LLM OS. From that desk, say "install LLM OS alongside macOS" (or Windows) to put it on the computer.

Stick: USB 3.0 or faster, 8 GB minimum, 16 GB recommended. Everything on it is erased.
Computer: any 64‑bit PC or Intel Mac from the last ~10 years, 4 GB RAM (8 GB comfortable), 32 GB free on the internal disk for an install.

On Windows the write needs administrator rights; a prompt will appear. If it is refused, write the ISO with Rufus (DD image mode) or balenaEtcher instead.
